text:
alex: Heads up — we're scheduling deprecation for the v1 'Unified Chat' API on 2026-06-30. Need migration guide + SDK snippets updated before comms. @marie can you own docs PR?
marie: ack. I'll draft the migration guide. Need examples for JS/Python + curl. Any hard breaking behaviors to call out? :eyes:
amazon: (bot) — sorry accidental paste, ignore.
sam: FYI I already found two links in the quickstart that still point to /v1 — I'll PR link fixes. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2101|#2101>
alex: Main breaking changes: streaming framing and function-calling payload shape changed. Also model param swap (model: 'unified-chat-v1' -> 'chat-unified-v2') and endpoint rename `/v1/chat` -> `/v2/messages`. Payload field `conversation` -> `messages`. Call these out in the guide.
jordan: Can we include a small compatibility shim for TS SDK? I can drop a tiny wrapper so apps don't break immediately.
jordan: ```ts
// ts-sdk compatibility shim
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk';
export function compatSend(client: Client, oldPayload: any) {
  const migrated = { messages: oldPayload.conversation || oldPayload.messages, model: oldPayload.model === 'unified-chat-v1' ? 'chat-unified-v2' : oldPayload.model };
  return client.post('/v2/messages', migrated);
}
```
marie: perfect — include that snippet. Also need a curl and python example showing function calling changes.
marie: curl example I'm planning:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/messages 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"chat-unified-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly metrics"}], "functions": [{"name":"summarize","parameters":{}}]}'
```
alex: Add callouts for token/latency differences and recommended quant profiles if customers pin to dedicated.
sam: PR #2101 (link fixes): replaced two `/v1` quickstart links with `/v2`, removed an old `conversation` example. Tiny change, tests pass.
docs-bot: Reminder — docs PRs must include the `migration` label and link to the deprecation RFC: <https://redwood.com/rfcs/15|RFC-15>. Also add `breaking-change` if the PR modifies snippets used in quickstart.
marie: Draft MR created: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2105|#2105> — includes JS, Python, and curl examples, a short migration checklist, and notes on streaming framing. Needs review + QA.
taylor: I'll update the deprecation email template and release notes blurb. Can someone paste the exact date/time for the deprecation announcement?
alex: locking date: 2026-06-30 18:00 UTC for public sunset notice. Add a customer-facing fallback recommendation: pin to `chat-unified-v2-compat` for 30 days to ease transition.
linh: QA note — streaming framing change affects our end-to-end tests. Please add a regression test plan that includes: 1) streaming frames parsing, 2) function call invocation case, 3) model param acceptance. I can write the matrix once snippets land.
jordan: I'll review the TS shim and add the snippet to the SDK examples page. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:
taylor: done — updated templates locally, will push after PR merges.
marie: thanks all — planning to merge after reviews are in. Target docs release next Tuesday and coordinate with comms for the email and blog. If anyone finds lingering /v1 links, ping me here.
sam: will grep the repo tonight and open any quick fixes.

alex: awesome. small followups: 1) add migration checklist at top of doc, 2) add note about Dedicated/Private behavior differences, 3) link to SDK shim in the migration TOC.
marie: noted. will iterate and tag reviewers @jordan @sam @linh.
marie: merging once approvals in, will post merged PR link here.
